title: Verify new ArgoCD sync alerts fire and route
description: The three alerts in k8s/charts/support-cluster/templates/monitoring/argocd-sync.yaml (ArgoCDAppSyncFailed, ArgoCDAppSyncPendingStuck, ArgoCDAppOutOfSync) were authored from dashboard-verified series names, never observed firing. Confirm each registers in vmalert rules API, then force one firing (e.g. temporarily lower the OutOfSync threshold against a paused app) and confirm Discord delivery, then restore.
notes: EVIDENCE 2026-10-15: vmalert /api/v1/rules lists argocd-sync.rules with all three alerts; ArgoCDAppSyncFailed AND ArgoCDAppOutOfSync both observed FIRING in production (no expr change needed, nothing to restore) and alertmanager notification log records both dispatched to monitoring-alertmanager-config-discord; ArgoCDAppSyncPendingStuck inactive by design (no stuck syncs). Acceptance: vmalert rules listed + >=1 alert firing with real Discord notification - met without forcing.
acceptance_criteria: vmalert /api/v1/rules lists the argocd-sync group; at least one of the three alerts observed firing with a real Discord notification; exprs restored to production values afterward.
